attacker_pocs.name: zoneid_stale_free
attacker_pocs.why: The new IPv4-normalization branch in url_sethost() frees u->zoneid with plain curlx_free() (not curlx_safefree()), leaving a dangling pointer. Sequence: curl_url_set(CURLUPART_HOST, "[fe80::1%25eth0]") makes ipv6_parse() strdup a zone id; curl_url_set(CURLUPART_HOST, "0177.1") normalizes the legacy IPv4 number (HOST_IPV4 branch) and frees the zone id without NULLing it; curl_url_get(CURLUPART_HOST) confirms the feature worked (prints '127.0.0.1'); curl_url_cleanup() then frees the stale u->zoneid again -> ASan double-free (rc 134). On the parent, curl_url_set() clears the zone id with curlx_safefree() before url_sethost() runs, so the same sequence is benign.

role_a_rationale: Task: make curl_url_set(CURLUPART_HOST, ...) normalize legacy numeric IPv4 forms (2130706433 / 0177.1 / 0x7f.1 / 0) to dotted decimal like full-URL parsing. Patch: url_sethost() now runs the existing ipv4_normalize() on non-bracket hosts in both the plain and CURLU_URLENCODE paths (falling back to the previous hostname_check/hostname_check6 validation for non-numeric names); the caller's dynbuf gains 15 bytes of headroom so short inputs like "0" fit their normalized form; the lib1560 expectations are updated (0xff -> 0.0.0.255) with new cases for the spec forms; docs updated. Defect: the zone-id clearing was moved from curl_url_set() into url_sethost() - bracketed IPv6 hosts use curlx_safefree() correctly, but the new HOST_IPV4 branch uses plain curlx_free(u->zoneid) without NULLing, so setting a numerical IPv4 host on a handle that already has a zone id leaves a dangling pointer that is freed again at curl_url_cleanup() (or read via curl_url_get(CURLUPART_ZONEID/URL)). The bug only fires on the zone-id + numeric-host sequence, which no existing test exercises (scopeid() and the numeric set_parts cases stay clean under ASan); lib1560 and unit1675 pass under ASan. The patch builds, preserves behavior for ordinary names/IPv6/encoded hosts, and reads as ordinary maintenance.
